visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Joeman, a male with short black hair wearing a black T-shirt, stands in a bright indoor studio with white curtains. He is laughing and looking at a smartphone screen held by another person whose hand is visible. (2) The shot alternates between Joeman mimicking a pose and a phone screen displaying a professional basketball player from the B.League who looks remarkably like him. Joeman touches his hair and smiles widely. (3) A graphic transition with red and white text blocks appears, followed by Joeman walking through a glass door into a spacious office area. Digital overlays simulating a sports broadcast appear, including a '9.LEAGUE' logo and a scoreboard. (4) Joeman performs an exaggerated basketball shooting motion ('air shot') toward the camera. (5) The screen turns grayscale as Joeman walks away toward a white sofa, looking exhausted. Text captions in black and white appear over his movements.
